Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you sent last week. Our audit team has a few follow-ups where they need supporting control artifacts beyond the PDF to close our assessment:

- MFA enforcement: a screenshot or config export showing policy enforcement for interactive logins and API clients (dates of last change).
- Auth log slice: authentication events (success/fail) for the period 2027-03-15 through 2027-04-15. We only need a sampled CSV (redacted usernames OK) that includes timestamp, source IP (first three octets ok), user role, auth_method, and success/failure reason where available.
- Privileged access review: the most recent admin/privileged account review document covering internal users with elevated roles (date and reviewer).
- Key/secret rotation evidence: a short statement or record for rotation of service credentials used by production inference services within the SOC 2 period.

If the Type II report does not cover certain days our auditors care about, they may also request a bridge letter stating any control changes and the dates — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short bridge note if needed?

Target date for artifacts: 2027-05-03 to align with our audit window. Let me know if any of the items require a Data Access Agreement or a separate secure upload method.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior InfoSec Analyst
Greenhill Health
security@greenhillhealth.com
